services.name: Fishing charter
services.desc: Sarasota Fishing Charter - Every trip is unique and the fishing experience tailored to each day and each client. Gear, bait, and bragging rights included. Family Friendly Fishing Charter Sarasota - Get the whole family out on the water! Sarasota Bay is an excellent place for kids and adults of all ages to learn how to cast a line and set a hook. Recommended for children 5 and up. Captain Will has been fishing the waters around Sarasota for over twenty years. You can count on him to put you on the fish and have an enjoyable day on the water. services.name: Nature and Sunset Tours
services.desc: During daytime trips take an excursion into Sarasota's backcountry and check out some of the amazing wildlife this coast has to offer. We will travel through rivers, along pristine beaches, and around islands in search of dolphins, manatees, and some great views of the beautiful birds local to our waterways. Evening sunset tours feature gorgeous glowing views of Sarasota Bay and the Gulf of Mexico. Bring your own refreshments for a relaxing evening out on the water.
